findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: everyinfra_list_capabilities, everyinfra_call_api, everyinfra_chat, everyinfra_search, everyinfra_get_topup_link, everyinfra_create_ticket, everyinfra_get_ticket · Private data: everyinfra_get_job, everyinfra_chat, everyinfra_list_captcha_types, everyinfra_solve_captcha, everyinfra_get_account, everyinfra_list_requests, everyinfra_create_ticket · Public sink: everyinfra_list_captcha_types, everyinfra_create_ticket · Destructive: everyinfra_chat, everyinfra_search.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: everyinfra_list_capabilities, everyinfra_call_api, everyinfra_chat, everyinfra_search, everyinfra_get_topup_link, everyinfra_create_ticket, everyinfra_get_ticket · Private data: everyinfra_get_job, everyinfra_chat, everyinfra_list_captcha_types, everyinfra_solve_captcha, everyinfra_get_account, everyinfra_list_requests, everyinfra_create_ticket · Public sink: everyinfra_list_captcha_types, everyinfra_create_ticket · Destructive: everyinfra_chat, everyinfra_search

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
